Treatment summary
Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with reported head
impact and subsequent headache, dizziness, and difficulty concentrating. Over six
visits, care consisted of symptom monitoring, cognitive and vestibular assessment,
graded activity guidance, and education on concussion precautions. The reported
mechanism of injury is consistent with the symptoms described and with the force of the
collision as documented. Neurological examination showed some findings supportive of
concussion, including mild balance deficits and reduced performance on attention
tasks, while other testing, including cranial nerve examination, coordination, and
strength, was within normal limits. No prior injury to the head or neck has been
identified in the available history. Treatment followed a typical course, with
frequency of vistis decreasing as symptoms improved and the patient returned toward
baseline function. Billing records reflect one charge per scheduled service with no
duplicate entries. Prognosis is good with continued gradual return to nromal
activities.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- objective_support: Do objective tests (imaging, exam findings) support the complaints? Allowed: Strong, Partial, Predominantly subjective, Contradicted.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- duplicate_billing: Was the same service, visit or part billed twice? Allowed: None, Possible, Confirmed.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
